title: Efficient Inference for Noisy LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated evaluations (surrogate outcomes) to a calibration set of gold-standard human labels to measure sensitivity and specificity, and correcting systematic overestimation or underestimation of performance metrics (like win rates) using measurement-error correction (e.g., Rogan-Gladen) and prediction-powered inference (PPI).
